formattedAddress: No. 16號, Lane 269, Section 5, Roosevelt Rd, Wanxiang Village, Wenshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 116

text.text:
We had the mushroom appetiser , the pork chop and the clam fettuccine . The appetiser was ok but the pork chop and fettuccine were outstanding ! The pork chop had a nice smokey flavour and was done perfectly . The clam fettuccine was full of fresh clams and this dish is totally garlic flavoured ; Excellent ! I had the guava and pineapple juice - very good 👍
The creme brûlée is a must order .
Overall a great find ….. good food , good prices and good service !

text.text:
The service wasn’t very friendly, the waiter gave us the menu and just stood next to us without saying anything (such as making recommendations) waiting to get the order, it was a very close distance and that felt very uncomfortable. Not sure what that was about. The waiter taking the check at the end was much nicer.
The restaurant seating arrangement was curious and inconvenient, there were two tables set at the busy entrance with not enough space to move around, there were pillows and a cat bed on the floor, it was simply too compact.
The two pasta dishes we ordered were delicious though, and the cat in the restaurant was adorable.

text.text:
I went there with some friends and sat outside on a cool day, which made the whole experience even better.

The food was pretty decent—I had the pasta with a generous amount of clams, and the set came with a tasty pumpkin cream soup. The hot coffee wasn’t bad either. Overall, I really enjoyed my time there.

For the value, I’d say the price is definitely worth it.
